sources.people: Source: people and needs – CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022 (ACS 2018–2022 estimates), HHS emPOWER and FEMA National Risk Index v1.20; community names – 2020 Census blocks and places, spellings from USGS GNIS.
sources.summary: Source: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022 (ACS 2018–2022 estimates), HHS emPOWER, FEMA National Risk Index v1.20; shelter rates: {SOURCES}.
sources.sites: Source: county announcements of sites opened in 2026; FEMA flood zones (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS, State DFIRM); tsunami evacuation zones (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS).
sources.needs: Source: likely estimate × planning factors ({SOURCES}; Florida Division of Emergency Management 2010; AVMA (2020 data) for pets).
sources.decisions: Source: National Weather Service, Central Pacific Hurricane Center and Pacific Tsunami Warning Center product definitions (links: {SOURCES}).
sources.languages: Source: ACS PUMS 2019–2023 5-year (validated against the DBEDT State of Hawaiʻi Data Book 2024, Table 1.44).
sources.detail: Source: ACS 2020–2024 5-year Census-area tables B18102 (hearing), B18103 (vision), B18104 (cognitive) and B09020 (age 65 and older living alone), times the share of each area in the risk area; homes in 10+ unit buildings: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 (E_MUNIT, housing units).
sources.county_lines: Source: Point-in-Time counts – Bridging the Gap 2026 report (Hawaiʻi, Maui, Kauaʻi; night of Jan 25, 2026) and Partners In Care 2026 count for Oʻahu as released by the City and County of Honolulu; visitors – DBEDT State of Hawaiʻi Data Book 2025, Table 7.06. sources.access: Site locations: U.S. Census Geocoder, checked against Esri ArcGIS World Geocoder. Travel times: Esri ArcGIS routing, normal traffic. Powered by Esri. Geocoding and routing: Esri ArcGIS Location Services.
sources.facilities: Source: CMS Provider Data Catalog (dialysis facilities, nursing homes, hospitals; facility addresses only), located with Esri ArcGIS World Geocoder; zones: State tsunami evacuation zone and FEMA flood zones (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS, State DFIRM).
sources.childcare: Source: Ready Keiki Locator, all pre-K sites (Office of the Lieutenant Governor, published through Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS): licensed group child care, public pre-K and charter pre-K sites only – no family child care homes; zones: State tsunami evacuation zone and FEMA flood zones (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS, State DFIRM).
sources.sirens: Source: Hawaiʻi Emergency Management Agency public siren map (locations of permanent outdoor warning sirens; no live status). Rated range: 3,400 feet, the manufacturer rating published by the Hawaiʻi Emergency Management Agency; the real range varies with terrain, buildings and weather. In range: within 3,400 feet of a siren, the same method as for the tsunami zone. Shares of people are 2020 Census block populations whose block internal point is inside (Census TIGER internal points), divided by the Census area's 2020 block population; the share is then applied to the area's population.
sources.dams: Source: State of Hawaiʻi dam evacuation zones (published through Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS). People = share of each Census area inside a zone × its population, the same method as for the tsunami zone. Shares of people are 2020 Census block populations whose block internal point is inside (Census TIGER internal points), divided by the Census area's 2020 block population; the share is then applied to the area's population.
sources.shares: Method: Shares of people are 2020 Census block populations whose block internal point is inside (Census TIGER internal points), divided by the Census area's 2020 block population; the share is then applied to the area's population.
sources.reach: Source: proposed channels and formats in the plan's communication pathways – supports, does not replace, county and State public-information plans.

messages.text: A Hurricane Watch is in effect. Hurricane conditions are possible; strong winds could arrive in about two days. Get ready now: medicines, water, food, phone chargers, and a plan for power for medical devices. If you will need a ride, tell someone now. Follow county announcements.

messages.text: A Hurricane Warning is in effect. Hurricane conditions are expected; strong winds could start in about 36 hours. If the county asks your area to evacuate, leave early while it is still calm. Follow county announcements for open shelters. If you are in danger, call 911.

messages.text: Ua hoʻopuka ʻia ka Hurricane Watch. Hiki paha ke hiki mai ka makani ikaika i loko o ʻelua lā. E hoʻomākaukau i kēia manawa: nā lāʻau lapaʻau, ka wai, ka meaʻai, ka mea hoʻouka uila kelepona, a me kahi papahana no ka uila o nā mīkini lapaʻau. Inā pono ʻoe i kaʻa, e haʻi i kekahi i kēia manawa. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana.

Ua hoʻopuka ʻia ka Hurricane Warning. Ke manaʻo ʻia nei ka hiki ʻana mai o ka makani ikaika i loko o 36 hola. Inā noi ke kalana e haʻalele kou wahi, e haʻalele koke ʻoiai ua mālie nō. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no nā wahi hoʻomalu (shelter) e wehe ʻia ana. Inā pilikia ʻoe, e kelepona i ka 911.

Ua wehe ʻia nā wahi hoʻomalu (shelter) no ka lehulehu. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no ka ʻike ʻana i nā wahi hoʻomalu i wehe ʻia a me ko lākou wahi. E lawe pū i nā lāʻau lapaʻau, ka ID, a me ka mea hoʻouka uila kelepona. Inā he holoholona hānai kāu, e nānā i nā lula a ke kalana no nā holoholona. Inā pono ʻoe i ke kōkua e hele ai, e kelepona i kou kalana. ʻAʻole ʻoe hoʻokahi.

Kiʻekiʻe ka pōʻino ahi (Red Flag Warning). Hiki ke ʻā a laha wikiwiki ke ahi. E hoʻomākaukau i nā lāʻau lapaʻau a me nā palapala koʻikoʻi, e mālama i ka uila o ke kelepona, a e hoʻolālā i kaʻa inā ʻaʻohe ou kaʻa. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana.

Ua kauoha ke kalana e haʻalele kou wahi. E haʻalele i kēia manawa. Mai kali a ʻike ʻoe i ka uahi a i ʻole ke ahi. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no kahi e hele ai. Inā pilikia ʻoe, e kelepona i ka 911.

Ua wehe ʻia nā wahi hoʻomalu (shelter) no ka lehulehu. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no ka ʻike ʻana i nā wahi hoʻomalu i wehe ʻia a me ko lākou wahi. E lawe pū i nā lāʻau lapaʻau, ka ID, a me ka mea hoʻouka uila kelepona. Inā he holoholona hānai kāu, e nānā i nā lula a ke kalana no nā holoholona. Inā pono ʻoe i ke kōkua e hele ai, e kelepona i kou kalana. ʻAʻole ʻoe hoʻokahi.

Inā ʻike ʻoe i ke ōlaʻi ikaika a i ʻole ka emi ʻana o ke kai, e neʻe koke i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe. Mai kali i ka hoʻolaha kūhelu. E ʻimi i kēia manawa inā aia kou hale, kou wahi hana a i ʻole kou kula i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe (tsunami evacuation zone).

Ua hoʻopuka ʻia ka Tsunami Warning. Inā aia ʻoe i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe, e hele i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe i kēia manawa, ma ka wāwae inā hiki. E noho mamao mai kahakai a hiki i ka wā e haʻi ai nā luna ua pau ka pōʻino.

Ua wehe ʻia nā wahi hoʻomalu (shelter) no ka lehulehu. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no ka ʻike ʻana i nā wahi hoʻomalu i wehe ʻia a me ko lākou wahi. E lawe pū i nā lāʻau lapaʻau, ka ID, a me ka mea hoʻouka uila kelepona. Inā he holoholona hānai kāu, e nānā i nā lula a ke kalana no nā holoholona. Inā pono ʻoe i ke kōkua e hele ai, e kelepona i kou kalana. ʻAʻole ʻoe hoʻokahi.
Hiki i ka ua nui ke hoʻoulu wikiwiki i ka wai hālana. E ʻike i ke ala i kahi kiʻekiʻe. Mai hele wāwae a holo kaʻa paha i loko o ka wai e kahe ana. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana.
Ua hoʻopuka ʻia ka Flash Flood Warning. E neʻe i kahi kiʻekiʻe i kēia manawa. Mai ʻaʻe i nā alanui a i ʻole nā kahawai i piʻi ka wai. Inā pilikia ʻoe, e kelepona i ka 911.

Ua wehe ʻia nā wahi hoʻomalu (shelter) no ka lehulehu. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana no ka ʻike ʻana i nā wahi hoʻomalu i wehe ʻia a me ko lākou wahi. Inā pono ʻoe i ke kōkua e hele ai, e kelepona i kou kalana. ʻAʻole ʻoe hoʻokahi.
Hiki i ke kai piʻi a me nā nalu ke hoʻopiʻi i ka wai ma kahakai. E hoʻoneʻe i nā kaʻa a me nā mea mai kahakai aku, a e hoʻolālā i kahi e hele ai. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana.

Ua hoʻopuka ʻia ka Coastal Flood Warning. Hiki paha ke piʻi ka wai ma kahakai i loko o 12 hola. Inā noho ʻoe kokoke i kahakai, e neʻe i kahi kiʻekiʻe a e hōʻalo i nā alanui kahakai. E hahai i nā hoʻolaha a ke kalana.

Adda Hurricane Watch. Mabalin nga adda bagyo; mabalin a dumteng ti napigsa nga angin iti uneg ti agarup dua nga aldaw. Agsagana itan: agas, danum, taraon, charger ti telepono, ken plano para iti kuryente dagiti medical device. No masapulmo ti lugan, ibagam itan iti maysa a tao. Surotem dagiti anunsio ti county.

Adda Hurricane Warning. Mapadpadles ti bagyo; mabalin a rumugi ti napigsa nga angin iti uneg ti agarup 36 nga oras. No ibaga ti county nga agbakwit ti lugaryo, pumanawkayo a nasapa bayat a natalna pay. Surotem dagiti anunsio ti county maipapan kadagiti nakalukat a shelter. No addaka iti peggad, tawagam ti 911.

Adda dagiti nakalukat a publiko a shelter. Surotem dagiti anunsio ti county tapno maammuam no ania dagiti shelter a nakalukat ken no sadino ti ayanda. Mangiyegka iti agas, ID, ken charger ti telepono. No addaan ka iti taraken nga ayup, kitaem dagiti pagannurotan ti county para kadagiti taraken. No masapulmo ti tulong tapno makadanonka sadiay, kontakem ti county-mo. Saanka nga agmaymaysa.

Adda Tsunami Warning. No addaka iti tsunami evacuation zone, mapanka itan iti nangato a lugar wenno adayo iti baybay, magna no kabaelam. Umadayoka iti igid ti baybay agingga nga ibaga dagiti opisial nga awanen ti peggad.

Ti napigsa a tudo ket mabalin a mangpataud iti kellaat a layus a napardas unay. Ammuem no kasano ti mapan iti nangatngato a lugar. Saanka a pulos a magna wenno agmaneho iti agay-ayus a danum. Surotem dagiti anunsio ti county.

Các nơi trú ẩn công cộng đang mở cửa. Hãy theo dõi thông báo của quận để biết nơi trú ẩn nào đang mở và ở đâu. Hãy mang theo thuốc men, giấy tờ tùy thân và đồ sạc điện thoại. Nếu có thú cưng, hãy xem quy định của quận về thú cưng. Nếu cần giúp đỡ để đến đó, hãy liên lạc với quận. Quý vị không đơn độc.

Nguy cơ cháy rất cao (Cảnh báo Cờ Đỏ – Red Flag Warning). Lửa có thể bùng lên và lan rất nhanh. Hãy chuẩn bị thuốc men và giấy tờ quan trọng, giữ điện thoại luôn có pin, và sắp xếp phương tiện đi lại nếu quý vị không có xe. Hãy theo dõi thông báo của quận.
Quận đã ra lệnh sơ tán khu vực của quý vị. Hãy rời đi ngay. Đừng chờ đến khi thấy khói hoặc lửa. Hãy theo thông báo của quận để biết nên đi đâu. Nếu gặp nguy hiểm, hãy gọi 911.

Nếu quý vị cảm thấy động đất mạnh hoặc thấy nước biển rút ra xa, hãy lập tức đi vào sâu trong đất liền hoặc lên chỗ cao. Đừng chờ cảnh báo chính thức. Hãy tìm hiểu ngay xem nhà, nơi làm việc hoặc trường học của quý vị có nằm trong vùng sơ tán sóng thần hay không.

Đang có Cảnh báo Sóng thần (Tsunami Warning). Nếu quý vị ở trong vùng sơ tán sóng thần, hãy đi ngay vào đất liền hoặc lên chỗ cao, đi bộ nếu có thể. Hãy tránh xa bờ biển cho đến khi nhà chức trách thông báo đã hết nguy hiểm.

Mưa lớn có thể gây lũ quét rất nhanh. Hãy biết đường đi đến chỗ cao hơn. Đừng bao giờ đi bộ hoặc lái xe qua dòng nước đang chảy. Hãy theo dõi thông báo của quận.
Đang có Cảnh báo Lũ quét (Flash Flood Warning). Hãy lên chỗ cao hơn ngay. Đừng băng qua đường hoặc suối bị ngập. Nếu gặp nguy hiểm, hãy gọi 911.

stress.not_no_shelter: This is not a statement that the area has no shelter: counties designate and open shelters for each event, and many public buildings are not on the 2026 list.

hub.maui_2013: Tsunami Safe Zones for Maui, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi date from 2013; the other counties' zones date from 2025. Check Maui County's current evacuation maps.
hub.pdc_note: 2009 reference capacity (American Red Cross Hawaiʻi State Chapter, via the Pacific Disaster Center, ground condition October 2009): may be outdated. Use only as a starting point; confirm with the county.

sources.safe_zones: Tsunami Safe Zones (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS; Hawaiʻi Island, Oʻahu and Kauaʻi zones 2025, Maui County zones 2013), simplified outline.
sources.fire: State Fire Risk Areas (DLNR Division of Forestry and Wildlife, 2007; boundaries confirmed 2022, via Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS), simplified outline. The plan's wildfire numbers use the FEMA National Risk Index; this layer is a comparison.
sources.flooded: Potential flooded highways with 3.2 ft of sea level rise (Hawaiʻi Sea Level Rise Viewer, PacIOOS, via Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS). Chronic flooding later this century, not an event forecast.

assumptions.people_per_trip: 20 people per vehicle trip (team assumption: the plan gives no value)
assumptions.outage: 0 days = the plan: outlets for people in shelter only

how.people_in_shelter: People in the risk area × shelter-seeking rate.
how.cots: One cot per person in shelter (rounded up).
how.floor_sqft: 20 sq ft per person for stays up to 3 days, 40 sq ft beyond (Florida DEM 2010; past 14 days a team assumption).
how.water: 1 gallon per person per day (Florida DEM 2010) × days of stay.
how.meals: 2 meals per person per day (Florida DEM 2010) × days of stay.
how.toilets: 1 per 40 people for stays up to 3 days, 1 per 20 beyond (Florida DEM 2010).
how.outlets: 1 outlet per power-dependent person in shelter (HHS emPOWER-based estimate; team assumption). During a power outage: 1 charge a day for every power-dependent resident in the risk area, if that is more (team assumption, upper bound).
how.staff: Florida DEM (2010) ratios per shift: registration 1 per 165, dormitory 1 per 100, meals 1 per 110, mental health 1 per 250, health 1 per 200, security 1 per 100, sanitation 1 per 200 (each at least 1); children's area 1 per 12 children.
how.interpreters: People with limited English in shelter × each language's share of limited-English speakers (ACS PUMS 2019–2023). Each person may need an interpreter; it is not a count of interpreters.
how.support: People in shelter × the share needing support. Plan default: the share of people in shelter with a disability (ACS via CDC SVI).
how.trips: People in households without a car in the risk area ÷ people per vehicle trip, rounded up (an upper bound: not all will need a ride).
how.pets: Households in shelter × 44.6% with a dog and 26% with a cat (AVMA, 2020 data).
how.allocation: Each Census area's people in shelter go to the nearest usable 2026 site on the same island by drive time (Esri ArcGIS, normal traffic). Capacity is compared only when you enter it.
